title: Orbital Knitwear
openIssues: Card pars are not baked yet: the spec gives prototype-calibrated pass thresholds and par seeds (SPEC 5.4), and the engineer must run the offline brute-force search, bake par setups into js/cards.js and lower any pass level the search cannot reach (floor(0.95*par)).

If the polar view is cut (cut-list item 1), packaging should drop the fingerprint tag polar-view and keyword azimuthal from project.json; PROJECT.json description and makingOf deliberately do not mention the polar view.

The sourced NASA tutorial figure of about 22.9 degrees of westward track shift per ISS pass differs from the model's 23.4 to 23.8 degrees at 370 to 460 km; the About text discloses this as a computed difference. If the engineer's model lands elsewhere, the About sentence and test vector must be updated together.

SPEC.md is far longer than the 900 to 1500 word guide (about 6k whitespace tokens, 42k characters) because an 11-file, two-owner interface contract with events, DOM ids, hash grammar and test vectors needed it; the spec lint has only minimum lengths. DESIGN.md is also over its 400-word guide (closed toast-copy list).
One source title is poor but kept verbatim from the idea file: 'pubs.usgs.gov' (USGS fact sheet). Packaging may rename it if the lint allows.
Dawn Patrol is season-asymmetric (dawn node -90 scores about 0.81, dusk node +90 about 0.41 at the equinox epoch); the card text only asks for sunrise and the hint says start longitude near -90.
